citation: Closed forms of f(R). The first ten are examples in Sotiriou and Faraoni, arXiv:0805.1726. Later records cite Hu–Sawicki, Tsujikawa, exponential gravity, Appleby–Battye, Miranda et al., Nojiri–Odintsov, Kruglov, and Pérez-Romero and Nesseris. Not a released catalog.
